notes.zh: 审阅说明：脚本中该选项的权重在“存在科学家议员”时为0，而事件触发要求存在科学家议员，二者矛盾；仅当抽签后的60–120天内状态变化才可能发生。
notes.en: Review note: this branch has weight 0 whenever a councilor scientist exists, yet the event itself requires one; it can only fire if that changes during the 60-120 day delay.

scope.zh: 科学枢纽建成后的三条十年期随机后续：青春之泉（含项目链）、被绑架的科学家、神经库。
scope.en: The three decade-pulse follow-ups of a completed Science Nexus: Fountain of Youth (with its project chain), Abducted Leader, Neural Bank.
